title: 1974 Otago Southern Alps Expedition
content: An early spring morning hike on the foothills of the Southern Alps where we found the rare blue tussock. The air was crisp, freezing cold, and we huddled around a tiny kerosene stove warming our fingers on enamel mugs of black tea.

title: The Secret to Lavender Jasmine Tea
content: Never boil the lavender directly in the kettle. Steep dried English lavender with fresh jasmine blossoms for exactly four minutes, then add a droplet of manuka honey. Peggy always served this whenever Clara felt anxious before school exams.

title: Favorite Poem: The Peace of Wild Things by Wendell Berry
content: 'When despair for the world grows in me and I wake in the night at the least sound... I come into the peace of wild things who do not tax their lives with forethought of grief.' Peggy recorded reciting this onto a cassette tape for Clara when she moved away to university.

title: Sitting in the Sunlit Conservatory
content: Sitting quietly in the conservatory surrounded by potted silver ferns and flowering jasmine, with morning light pouring through the glass panes. She would watch the fantails (piwakawaka) dance outside the window.
